messages:
michael: Quick Q — planning to enable a per-customer flag for ProdCorp (VIP). Proposal: allowlist + contract gating, 5% canary scoped to their tenant, and automatic rollback guardrails. Details below.

michael: config idea:
```yaml
customer_id: prodcorp
flag: new_syntax_highlighter
rollout: 5%
sampling: session
contract_check: required
fallback_variant: safe_model_v1
override_ttl: 24h
```

nina: Sounds good. Who's owning the infra changes? I can own metric checks (latency, error rate, token-cost).

jamal: I can wire up the canary slice in feature-service. Will add allowlist handling in tenant-mode and a contract entitlement check in auth. Need to confirm if sampling should be session-based or per-request.

sam: session-based sampling please — keeps UX consistent for a user session.

michael: agree on session sampling. Also: add a manual kill switch endpoint and an automated rollback if ErrorRate > 0.5% sustained for 10m or latency +25% over baseline.

emily: Ops notes: make sure logs tag tenant_id and flag_variant. Add alerts: prodcorp-canary-error-rate and prodcorp-canary-latency. Notify SRE + PM on trigger.

jamal: I'll open a PR. Plan: add runtime flag, config in `/configs/tenant_flags/prodcorp.yaml`, and a canary policy entry in rollout service.

deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: branch `canary-prodcorp` -> staging -> canary (internal id 1972000500).

ops-bot: Canary started for ProdCorp at 1972000600 — dashboard: https://dash/reports/prodcorp-canary (monitoring hooks live).

nina: Quick q: how do we validate token-cost regression? Should we add cost buckets to traces or a separate metric?

michael: Add both: trace tags for token_count/response_bytes and a derived metric `prodcorp_canary_tokens_per_response`.

emily: Also add a metric for fallback hits (count of responses served by `fallback_variant`) — that indicates quality regressions.

jamal: PR created: https://git.example/r/redwood/feature-flags/pull/987 — includes configs + gating + alert rules. Assigning @michael for review.

michael: Reviewing now, will do a quick pass and then merge if green. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary ramp: set to 5% session sampling for tenant `prodcorp` at 1972000900.

ops-bot: Alerting rules added to staging: `prodcorp-canary-error-rate`, `prodcorp-canary-latency`, `prodcorp-canary-token-cost`.

nina: Running eval suite against canary prompts now, will post summary.

nina: Eval summary: 50 representative prompts, quality delta -0.2% (within tolerance), avg latency +12ms, token cost +1.8% — looks okay for canary.

michael: Good signal. Assuming stable for 1h without alerts, we plan to roll to 100% for the tenant. Notify here prior to full ramp.

emily: Added rollback playbook link: https://wiki.internal/rollback-playbook (steps + contacts).

jamal: Merged PR and deployed canary at 1972001100.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment finished for `prodcorp` at 1972001145 — no automatic rollback triggered.

ops-bot: No alerts fired during 45m window. Continued monitoring for 1h.

michael: Thanks everyone — closing this coordination thread. If anything spikes, open an incidents thread and ping SRE.
